_definitions.ci_all_draws: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles over all 1,000 joint bootstrap draws; a draw whose curve never crosses within 200 is ranked above 200; 'inf' = bound above 200
_definitions.ci_finite_draws_only_submitted_rule: submitted rule: percentiles of the crossing draws only; upper bound 'inf' whenever any draw fails to cross
_definitions.mc_se_over_splits: SD of the 50 per-split Spearman-Brown values divided by sqrt(50): Monte Carlo SE of the reported mean
_definitions.bias_g, brier_g: guess-corrected coding c' = .25 + .75 c (rating 0 read as the 25% guessing rate of a four-option item)
_definitions.auroc: tie convention (submitted code); auroc_pr = plan rule, undefined wherever gamma is undefined
_definitions.pool_sensitivity: Design A without students whose rated answers have accuracy >= .99 or one constant rating (computed on all of their rated answers); rows removed after subsampling and splitting
_definitions.r15: interpolated_10_20 = frozen H2 quantity (log-linear between N = 10 and 20); direct = grid point N = 15 (addendum 1)
